summary: Phase 4 Staff Planner testing completed. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working: monthly grid, template selector, coverage bar, month navigation, role filter, view toggle, overtime panel, agency staff badges.

issues: 60-second idle timeout may auto-logout during testing (same as previous phases)

backend_api: GET /api/planner/templates - Returns 4 templates (early, late, night, long_day) with correct times
GET /api/planner/monthly?year=2026&month=2 - Returns staff, shifts, coverage, stats
POST /api/planner/assign - Assigns shift with template to employee on date
POST /api/planner/assign - Duplicate shift on same date returns 400 error
POST /api/planner/assign - Consecutive days violation returns warnings with requires_confirmation
POST /api/planner/assign with force=true - Overrides warnings and creates shift
PUT /api/planner/move - Moves shift to new date
GET /api/planner/coverage?date=2026-02-06 - Returns coverage per template with baseline
frontend_flows: Manager demo login: Manager button -> PIN 1234 -> /manager dashboard
Navigation: Staff Planner button (data-testid='planner-nav') navigates to /manager/planner
Planner page: data-testid='staff-planner-page' loads with monthly grid
Monthly grid: Shows 14 staff rows × 28 day columns for February 2026
Coverage bar: Color-coded bars showing coverage status per day (red=below baseline, green=OK)
Shift cells: Show labels (E, L, N, LD) with color coding matching templates
Agency staff: Kate Collins & Mark Hughes show 'AGY' badge and orange avatars
Agency shifts: Marked with asterisk (*) suffix
Month navigation: prev-month/next-month buttons work (January <-> February <-> March)
Role filter: Dropdown filters to Nurses/Sr Carers/Carers/Agency/Activities/Kitchen
View toggle: On Duty shows shifts, Off Duty shows 'OFF' labels and 'AL' for Annual Leave
Overtime panel: Toggle shows Hours column with total hours and overtime (e.g., '180h +36h OT')
Hover shift cell: Hovering shows remove (X) button

seed_data_creation: Database seeded via POST /api/planner/seed-month for Feb 2026. Creates ~200+ shifts for 14 staff members.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Staff Planner fully tested. All planner APIs working: templates return 4 shift types with correct times, monthly view shows grid with staff × days, assign/unassign/move shifts work with rule validation (consecutive days warning, rest gap warning, duplicate shift error), force=true overrides warnings, overtime returns per-staff data, coverage shows baseline status. Frontend: Manager can navigate to /manager/planner via sidebar, grid shows color-coded shifts, template selector works, filters work (role, view mode), month navigation works, overtime panel toggles hours column, agency staff have AGY badges and orange avatars. Coverage bar shows red for below-baseline days. Shift cells show E/L/N/LD labels with colors.
